name: Agent Approval Gate
description: When an agent asks permission: the exact command or diff, a risk tag, and Allow once, Always allow here or Deny. Keyboard first, with a timer that runs only while seen.

props.name: agent
props.description: Name of the agent asking. Shown in the eyebrow, the denial placeholder and the file-write note.

props.name: request
props.description: What the agent wants to do. Chooses the title, the exact command, the diff, the touch tag and the three facets.

props.name: risk
props.description: How serious the request is in its context. Colours the touch tag (medium uses its own amber, never the accent) and picks the note in its tooltip, which is written for each request.

props.name: showDiff
props.description: Show the diff under the command when the request has one. The command always shows.

props.name: countdown
props.description: Seconds until the request is denied on its own. 0 turns the countdown off. The clock runs only while the card is in view. It pauses while the pointer is over the card, while focus is on a control, while the card is off screen and while the tab is hidden, and it never starts unseen.

props.name: status
props.description: Drive the card from outside: pending resets it and clears an earlier answer; approved or denied folds it into the receipt.

props.name: onDecision
props.description: Called once with the answer: once, always (with its scope), deny (with an optional reason) or timeout.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one brand accent: the primary button, the countdown bar and the selected scope dot. Defaults to ink for the theme (near-white on dark, near-black on light), so the primary action is never amber. Passing either ink ("#f4f4f5" or "#111113") also means ink and follows the theme, which is why the default swatch stays correct in the light theme. The ink that sits on it is picked for contrast. Risk colours are fixed.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black card with white ink, or the white inverse.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focus the card once it is in view, so Y, A and N answer without a Tab. Shows a quiet outline on the card while the keys are live. The demo turns it on.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the card.

name: Agent Diff Review
description: Review an agent's changes hunk by hunk: Accept or Reject each, rejected hunks fold to a stub, a file rail with +/− counts and a summary that applies what you kept.

props.name: agent
props.description: Name of the agent that proposed the change. Shown in the eyebrow, beside each hunk note and in the applied receipt.

props.name: title
props.default: "Round money once, in each currency’s own minor unit"
props.description: What the change does, in the agent's words.

props.name: summary
props.description: One or two sentences under the title: why, and what happens on apply.

props.name: proposedAt
props.description: When the agent proposed it, shown in the eyebrow on wider containers.

props.name: runId
props.description: Short run id shown in the eyebrow on wider containers.

props.name: changes
props.description: The change set. Each file has a path, an optional language ("code" or "prose") and hunks with an id, oldStart, newStart, scope, optional note and unified diff lines ({ kind: "ctx" | "add" | "del", text }).

props.name: files
props.description: Show only the first N files of changes. Defaults to all of them; the demo shows 3.

props.name: view
props.description: One column with old and new interleaved, or old and new side by side. The header toggle switches it too. Split needs about 900px; narrower, it reads as unified.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Wrap long lines instead of scrolling them sideways. Unwrapped, each hunk (or each side in split) scrolls on its own.

props.name: lineNumbers
props.description: Show old and new line numbers in a gutter.

props.name: defaultDecisions
props.description: Decisions to start from, keyed by hunk id. Anything missing starts pending.

props.name: onDecisionsChange
props.description: Called whenever a hunk is accepted, rejected or reopened, and when a whole file is accepted.

props.name: status
props.description: Drive the review from outside: review reopens it with decisions kept, applied locks it into the receipt.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: Called when Apply succeeds and when the person goes back to review.

props.name: onApply
props.description: Runs on Apply accepted. Return a promise to show the applying state; reject it to stay in review.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one brand accent: the Apply button, accepted marks and the summary strip. Defaults to the theme's ink; either ink ("#f4f4f5" or "#111113") follows the theme. The ink on it is picked for contrast. Additions and removals keep their own green and red.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black review with white ink, or the white inverse.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Shown when changes is an empty array.

name: Agent Plan
description: A numbered agent plan you reorder and rename before approving, then watch tick through live with timings, a shimmer on the active step and substeps unfolding beneath it.

props.name: title
props.description: The goal the plan serves, in the display face.

props.name: summary
props.default: "Drafted from your request and the current schema. Nothing runs until you approve."
props.description: One line under the title while the plan is a draft.

props.name: steps
props.description: The proposed steps in order. { id, title, duration? (ms of real run time, shown as the estimate), substeps?, outcome?, reason? }. Keep the array stable between renders.

props.name: stepCount
props.description: How many of the steps to propose, from the top (3 to 8).

props.name: state
props.description: Controlled phase. Omit to let the plan manage its own run.

props.name: defaultState
props.description: Starting phase when uncontrolled.

props.name: onStateChange
props.description: Called on approve, pause, resume, retry, edit and when the run finishes or fails.

props.name: onApprove
props.description: Called with the steps in their final order and wording when the plan is approved.

props.name: editable
props.description: Steps can be dragged, reordered with Alt and the arrow keys, and renamed in draft.

props.name: showTimings
props.description: Estimates in draft, measured times while running and after.

props.name: speed
props.description: Playback multiplier for the run's clock. The plan's times stay real: 2 plays the same run in half the wall time.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one colour: the approve, resume and retry buttons, and the active step's mark. Everything else is ink and grey.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black card with white ink, or the white inverse.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root element.

name: Agent Run Trace
description: A tracing waterfall for one agent run: nested LLM, tool and retrieval spans on a shared time axis, tokens and cost per span, a marked critical path and a details pane.

props.name: trace
props.description: Your run as flat spans: id, parentId, name, kind (agent, step, llm, tool, retrieval), start and duration in ms, plus optional model, tokensIn, tokensOut, cost, status, statusNote, input and output. Omit it to show the sample support-triage run.

props.name: spans
props.description: How many spans of the sample run to show, 6 to 30, cut in call order. Ignored when trace is set.

props.name: groupBy
props.description: Nest rows as the call tree, with collapsible steps and the critical path joined by connectors, or group them into LLM calls, tool calls and retrieval.

props.name: zoom
props.description: Time axis magnification, 1 to 4. Above 1 the lanes scroll sideways under a pinned span column and the selected span is kept in view.

props.name: showCost
props.description: Show cost in the totals, the span column, tooltips and the details pane.

props.name: live
props.description: Replays the run as if it were still in progress: spans arrive as they start, bars grow, totals count and a live edge sweeps the axis. Loops while on screen; a still snapshot with reduced motion.

props.name: defaultSelectedId
props.description: The span open in the details pane on mount. Defaults to the root span; null starts with the pane closed.

props.name: onSelectSpan
props.description: Called when a span is selected, or with null when the details pane closes.

props.name: runName
props.description: The agent or run name in the header.

props.name: runLabel
props.description: The line beside the name: what the run was for.

props.name: runId
props.description: Shown in mono above the name.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: critical path bars, connectors and the live edge.

props.name: theme
props.description: Greyscale palette for the surface, bars and text.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes on the root, for width and placement.

name: Agent Budget Guard
description: When an agent's next step would cross a spend, token or time cap: meters with the projected step drawn past the cap, and Approve, Raise cap or Stop.

props.name: agent
props.description: Name of the agent that paused.

props.name: run
props.description: What the run is doing, shown beside the agent.

props.name: step
props.description: The step the agent paused before.

props.name: steps
props.description: The run's expected number of steps.

props.name: action
props.type: { title: string; tool: string; detail: string; spread?: number }
props.description: The paused step: what it does, the tool it calls, its specifics and the ± uncertainty of its money projection.

props.name: budgets
props.description: Each limit: { id, label, kind: "money" | "tokens" | "time" | "count", used, next, cap }. next is the paused step's projected cost in the same unit. Rows with a duplicate id or a non-finite figure are left out.

props.name: history
props.description: Money spent by each finished step, oldest first. Drawn as a strip with the projected step last.

props.name: showHistory
props.description: Show the spend-per-step strip.

props.name: raiseBy
props.description: Amounts offered for raising the money cap. The first that clears the projection is preselected.

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO 4217 code for money figures.

props.name: locale
props.description: Number formatting locale.

props.name: status
props.description: Drive the card from outside: pending resets it; the others fold it into its receipt.

props.name: onDecision
props.type: (decision: { verdict: "approve" | "raise" | "stop"; cap?: number; at: number }) => void | Promise<void>
props.description: Called with the choice. A returned promise holds the button busy; a rejection keeps the card open, the drafted cap intact, and shows the error.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the primary action and the projected step's hatch. Either theme's ink follows the theme.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black card with white ink, or the white inverse.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focus the card once it is in view so Y, R and S answer at once. The demo turns it on.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the card.

name: Agent Dependency Board
description: An agent plan as a graph: tasks laid out by dependency depth, edges that draw, the critical path in the accent and an inspector to start or retry work.

props.name: tasks
props.description: The plan: id, title, agent, estimate in minutes, status (done, running, queued, failed), progress 0–1 while running, dependsOn ids and an optional one-line note. Repeated ids keep the first; unknown dependencies and loops are reported under the graph and left out of it. Defaults to a ten-task billing migration.

props.name: title
props.description: The plan's name.

props.name: planId
props.description: Shown in mono above the title.

props.name: selectedId
props.description: Controlled selection. Pair with onSelect.

props.name: defaultSelectedId
props.description: The task open in the inspector on mount. Defaults to the first running task.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called when a task is selected from the graph, a chip or the bottleneck link.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Start a ready task, retry a failed one or stop a running one. A returned promise shows progress in the button; a rejection shows its message under it and the button comes back. Without it the button is disabled.

props.name: layout
props.description: Columns left to right by dependency depth, rows top to bottom, or whichever fits the card. A forced across layout scrolls sideways inside the card when it has to.

props.name: showCritical
props.description: Mark the critical path: the chain of unfinished work that decides the finish time, and the bottleneck at its head.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: critical path edges, card rails and the bottleneck.

props.name: theme
props.description: Greyscale palette for the card, graph and text.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes on the root, for width and placement.

name: Agent Run Replay
description: A replay desk for a finished agent run: a scrubbable timeline of tool calls, a transcript that follows the playhead and the workspace state at that moment.

props.name: run
props.description: The run in the header: id, title, agent, requester (initials in the transcript), optional repo and branch, and outcome (completed, failed or stopped). Defaults to the sample checkout-fix run.

props.name: events
props.description: The recording: id, at and duration in ms, kind (prompt, thinking, tool, reply), title, optional args, body, status, tokens, cost, files changed and a test result. Records without an id or a usable time are skipped and repeated ids keep the first. Defaults to 13 events of the sample run.

props.name: defaultTime
props.description: Where the playhead starts, in ms. Clamped to the run.

props.name: time
props.description: Controlled playhead in ms. Pair with onTimeChange; without it the playhead is read-only. A host that does not take a playback frame stops playback.

props.name: onTimeChange
props.description: Every requested playhead position: scrubbing, stepping, clicks on events and each frame of playback.

props.name: onEventChange
props.description: Called when the event under the playhead changes, or with null before the first one.

props.name: speed
props.description: Playback speed. The picker in the transport changes it too.

props.name: autoPlay
props.description: Start playing once the replay is on screen. Never with reduced motion.

props.name: showState
props.description: Show the state panel: files changed, the latest test run, tokens, cost and tool calls at the playhead.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the playhead, the played part of the timeline, the current event and running progress.

props.name: theme
props.description: Greyscale palette for the card, lanes and text.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes on the root, for width and placement.

name: Answer Comparison
description: Two AI answers side by side: a Differences lens highlights what only one says, shared citations, and a blind vote that reveals the models.

props.name: question
props.default: "Checkout p95 went from 380 ms to 1.2 s after Tuesday’s deploy. What should we look at first?"
props.description: The prompt both answers respond to, set in serif above them.

props.name: answers
props.default: Halcyon 2 and Northwind 4 on a latency regression
props.description: { id, model, latencyMs?, paragraphs: ComparePart[][], status?: "ready" | "loading" | "error", error? }. A part is { text, claim?, cite? }: spans in both answers with the same claim key are the same point; a key only one answer uses is a difference.

props.name: sources
props.description: { id, title, origin, quote? }. Numbered in this order; markers in either answer point here, and the rail shows which answer cites each one.

props.name: reasons
props.default: ["More accurate", "Better sourced", "More specific", "Easier to act on", "Shorter"]
props.description: Optional reasons offered once a preference is picked. Pass [] to hide them.

props.name: blind
props.description: Hide which model wrote which answer until the vote is recorded; the names then blur in.

props.name: defaultLens
props.description: Open in plain reading or with differences highlighted.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled recorded verdict { choice: "a" | "tie" | "b", reasons }. null means no vote yet.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial recorded verdict when uncontrolled.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Records the vote. Return a promise to show pending; a rejection keeps the choice and reasons and shows its message.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Shows Regenerate on an answer whose status is error.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the difference highlighter, the active citation, the chosen option and the preferred answer’s edge.

props.name: theme
props.description: Graphite or white surfaces.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes on the root.

controls.label: Question
controls.default: Checkout p95 went from 380 ms to 1.2 s after Tuesday’s deploy. What should we look at first?

name: Inline Citations
description: An AI answer with numbered markers on the baseline. Hover one to light the exact span it backs and open a source card; a rail groups duplicate sources.

props.name: question
props.default: "Why do teams cancel at their first renewal?"
props.description: The question the answer responds to, set in serif above the answer.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The question's heading level. Use h3 when the host page already owns the h2; the rail's Sources heading steps down with it.

props.name: answer
props.description: The answer as spans: { text, cite? }. Cited spans are highlighted when their marker is read. A cited span is marked by its last word, so the marker never wraps away from its claim.

props.name: sources
props.description: Retrieved sources in ranked order: { id, title, domain, monogram?, quote, match }. match must appear verbatim inside quote. Sources sharing a domain and title are grouped in the rail and share one marker number.

props.name: maxSources
props.description: How many sources, from the top of the list, may back the answer. Claims cited only to sources beyond it read as plain prose.

props.name: markerStyle
props.description: The marker on the baseline: a bare numeral, a 6px dot, or a boxed numeral chip.

props.name: showRail
props.description: Show the sources rail under the answer. Each source row quotes the sentences it backs and says how many claims that is; clicking a row pins its card on the first claim and moves focus there. The card names the other claims a source backs.

props.name: cardOnHover
props.description: Hovering a marker opens its source card, and moving to another marker glides the card there. The card is placed so it never covers another marker, and the pointer passes through an unpinned card. Off, a click opens and pins it, and the default hint says so. On touch the hint asks for a tap. A tap on another marker moves the card and pins it; a second tap on the pinned marker closes it. Escape closes a pinned card wherever focus is.

props.name: hint
props.description: The line under the answer that says how to read a source. Leave it out for the adaptive wording (hover, click, or tap on touch screens), pass your own copy, or pass false to hide it in a product view.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the highlighter wash behind a cited span, the active marker and the quote mark. A #rrggbb colour.

props.name: theme
props.description: Greyscale surfaces and ink. The accent stays the same in both themes.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root.

name: Context Budget
description: A context-window planner: every source is a segment of one big token bar that fills, splits and overflows live as you switch sources on.

props.name: sources
props.description: { id, label, kind, detail?, tokens, relevance?, required? }. kind is instructions | conversation | file | doc | transcript | web | code. tokens: null means still counting (the row can’t be switched on yet). Required sources show a lock and always count.

props.name: budget
props.description: The model’s context window in tokens. The limit hairline sits here; anything past it is washed red.

props.name: reservedTokens
props.description: Tokens held back for the answer, drawn as the hatched segment. The footer slider changes it locally; changing the prop resets it.

props.name: onReservedTokensChange
props.description: Called as the reserve slider moves.

props.name: maxReserve
props.description: Largest reserve the slider offers.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled ids of the optional sources that are switched on. Unknown ids, uncounted and required sources are ignored. Without onValueChange the switches are read-only.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initially included optional sources when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the next set of included optional ids (from a switch or Trim to fit).

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: The Attach button. Return a promise to show pending; a rejection keeps the selection and shows its message.

props.name: modelLabel
props.description: Small chip in the header naming the model and its window.

props.name: status
props.description: loading while your tokenizer counts: the figure, bar and rows hold shimmer skeletons.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the hovered segment and its row dot, and the Attach button.

props.name: theme
props.description: Graphite or white surfaces; the over-budget red is the only other colour.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes on the root card.

name: Image Generation
description: Four studies from one prompt, drawn in code. Each develops out of grain. Vary redraws the one you picked, and Upscale enlarges it.

props.name: prompt
props.default: "North light through a paper screen, one branch."
props.description: The brief, set in serif above the studies.

props.name: seed
props.description: Base seed. The studies use this value, then the next three. Changing it redraws all four. Read again whenever it changes.

props.name: status
props.description: Controlled frame. Grid is the four studies. Upscaled enlarges the selected one and keeps the others as a strip. Omit it and the desk owns the state.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: Called when Upscale or All four changes the frame.

props.name: onVary
props.description: Called with the study index and its new seed when Vary redraws it.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent, used on Upscale. A #rrggbb colour. Near-white or near-black values use the theme’s ink. The selected study is ringed in the print’s ink, and the sunlight in the pictures stays warm.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black surface with white ink, or the white inverse. The prints keep their paper.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root.

controls.label: Prompt
controls.default: North light through a paper screen, one branch.

name: MCP Elicitation
description: A tool call that pauses the thread and asks for the fields it cannot guess. A bad time is refused, a free one books, and the assistant continues.

props.name: userName
props.description: Who asked for the tool to run. Shown above their message.

props.name: request
props.default: "Hold Studio B for the design review on Thursday."
props.description: The message above the form.

props.name: agent
props.description: The assistant that paused for the tool.

props.name: pause
props.default: "calendar.hold stopped. It needs the fields it can’t guess."
props.description: The line under the request, before the form.

props.name: tool
props.description: Tool that asked for the fields. Shown in mono in the card header.

props.name: room
props.description: Room the tool is trying to hold. Used in the people line, the conflict and the receipt.

props.name: slots
props.description: Choices for when: { id, label, detail, available }. One of them is unavailable. detail is a short availability note such as “Held until 3”.

props.name: defaultSlot
props.description: Slot id selected before anyone touches the form. Read on mount. The default is the unavailable slot, so the conflict can be shown.

props.name: lengths
props.description: Lengths in minutes, shown as a segmented control.

props.name: defaultLength
props.description: Length selected before anyone touches the form. Read on mount.

props.name: guests
props.description: How many people. Pass it to control the count. Omit it and the stepper owns it, from 1 to 12.

props.name: capacity
props.description: Seats in the room. More guests than this blocks Continue and names the limit.

props.name: conflict
props.default: "Studio B is held by Finance until 3. 4:30 is open."
props.description: Why the unavailable slot is refused. Shown after Continue, not before.

props.name: confirmation
props.description: The line after a valid submit. {when}, {length}, {room} and {guests} are filled in.

props.name: status
props.description: Controlled state. Asking shows the form. Booked replaces it with the receipt and the assistant’s next line. Omit it and the thread owns the state.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: Called when a valid Continue books the room.

props.name: onSubmit
props.type: (value: { slotId: string; length: number; guests: number }) => void
props.description: Called with the accepted fields when the run resumes. A refused slot does not call it.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the selection dot, the length marker’s ink, and Continue. A #rrggbb colour. Near-white or near-black values use the theme’s ink so the button stays readable. Ink on the button is chosen for contrast.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black surface with white ink, or the white inverse.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root.

name: Model Picker
description: A model select that helps you choose: aligned speed, price and context bars, capability tags, typeahead, and a compare that diffs any model against the current one.

props.name: catalog
props.default: Eight fictional models from three labs
props.description: Every model on offer: id, name, a one-line note, tokensPerSecond, usdPerMillion (blended), contextTokens and capabilities ("vision", "tools", "long-context").

props.name: models
props.description: How many models from the catalogue to show, 3 to 8. Bars share one scale across what is visible.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled model id. Leave out to let the picker keep its own.

props.name: defaultValue
props.default: "meridian-pro" in the demo, otherwise the first model
props.description: Model id on first render when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Runs when a model is chosen by pointer or keyboard.

props.name: label
props.description: Mono label above the trigger, and the accessible name of the list.

props.name: layout
props.description: List: rows with the bars aligned in columns under a header. Grid: two columns of cards, each with its own labelled bars.

props.name: showCost
props.description: Shows the price column, its bars, its delta and the price on the trigger.

props.name: showCompare
props.description: Marks the current model on every bar and diffs the highlighted model against it, in the bars and in words. Off, the footer shows a count and a typeahead hint.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Opens the panel on first render without moving focus into it. The demo opens it.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one colour: the check, the stretch of a bar where the highlighted model beats the current one, and the winning deltas. Darkened toward the ink on light.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black trigger and panel with white ink, or the white inverse.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root. The panel opens below the trigger, so leave room under it.

name: Search Answer
description: An AI search answer page set like an editorial: a sources strip that loads first, the answer streaming with inline markers, follow-ups that fill the query box.

props.name: query
props.default: "Why does sourdough rise so slowly in winter?"
props.description: The question that was asked, set as the page's serif headline. A new query cross-fades the headline, folds the source list and drops any pinned source.

props.name: status
props.description: Searching fills the sources strip, with shimmering slots for sources still to come. Answering streams the answer under it with a caret. Done adds the follow-ups and the time taken.

props.name: sources
props.description: Retrieved sources in ranked order: { id, title, domain, snippet, monogram?, date?, href? }. Pass them as they arrive; each lands in the strip with a short rise. With href, tiles and rows are links that open in a new tab.

props.name: answer
props.description: The answer so far, as the model writes it. Paragraphs are split by a blank line and [n] cites the nth source. The first paragraph is set as the lede. New words settle in as they arrive, and a marker still arriving ('[1') is held back until it closes.

props.name: followUps
props.description: Questions to ask next. They slide in once the answer is done; a click types one into the query box and focuses it, so the reader can edit it before asking.

props.name: showFollowUps
props.description: Show the follow-ups section above the query box.

props.name: maxSources
props.description: How many sources, from the top of the list, are shown and may be cited. Markers pointing past it are dropped, so the answer only ever cites what the strip shows. The strip shows four tiles: all four sources, or three and a +N tile that opens the full list.

props.name: density
props.description: Reading sets a 16.5px answer with an 18.5px lede and two-line source titles; compact is 14.5px with one-line titles, for a side panel.

props.name: elapsedMs
props.description: How long the search took, shown in the status line once done (8 sources · 3.4 s).

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: The headline's level. The Sources and Ask next headings step down one level from it.

props.name: onAsk
props.description: Called with the trimmed text when the query box is submitted (Enter, or the Ask button). Shift+Enter adds a line. The box clears itself.

props.name: onSourceOpen
props.description: Called when a source tile or list row is clicked. A click also pins that source's spotlight; a second click or Escape releases it.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder and accessible label for the query box.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent, a #rrggbb colour: the live dot while searching, the spotlight wash behind the sentences a source backs, lit markers and the Ask button once there is text.

props.name: theme
props.description: Greyscale surfaces and ink. The accent stays the same in both.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root.

props.name: ask
props.description: Demo only. Default export only, not part of the component API. Runs one of the four scripted questions: sources load, then the answer streams.

props.name: speed
props.description: Demo only. Default export only, not part of the component API. Stream pace: 2 runs twice as fast. Changing it replays the current search at the new pace.

name: Side Panel
description: An editor docked beside a draft. Mark a sentence to pull it in as a chip, then apply the rewrite so the line highlights, with one undo.

props.name: agent
props.description: Name of the editor in the margin. The monogram is the first letter.

props.name: role
props.description: Role under the name.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Mono path above the draft. Truncates rather than wrapping.

props.name: draftMark
props.description: Quiet mark at the right of the path, such as a draft number.

props.name: heading
props.description: The question the draft answers, set in serif.

props.name: lede
props.description: One line under the question.

props.name: sentences
props.description: The draft, one sentence per block: { id, text, chip }. Clicking a sentence pulls its chip into the margin. chip is the short label.

props.name: suggestion
props.description: The note in the margin: { sentenceId, reason, rewrite }. sentenceId must match a sentence. Apply replaces that sentence with rewrite.

props.name: defaultContext
props.description: Sentence ids already pulled into the margin. Read on mount. The note’s sentence starts pulled, so the pair is visible before a click.

props.name: status
props.description: Controlled state. Idle shows the suggestion. Applied shows the rewrite in the draft, with the wash and Undo. Omit it and the panel owns the state.

props.name: onStatusChange
props.description: Called when Apply or Undo changes the state.

props.name: onApply
props.description: Called with the sentence id and the rewrite when Apply is used.

props.name: onUndo
props.description: Called with the sentence id when the rewrite is undone.

props.name: showContext
props.description: Show the chips pulled from the draft. Marks on the sentences stay either way.

props.name: applyLabel
props.description: Label on the button before the change lands.

props.name: undoLabel
props.description: Label on the same button once the change has landed. The button keeps its size.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the mark number, the rule on a marked sentence, the wash behind a rewrite, and Apply. A #rrggbb colour. Ink on the button is chosen for contrast.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black surface with white ink, or the white inverse. The accent stays the same.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root.

name: Structured Output Stream
description: Streamed JSON fills in token by token while a schema rail ticks off each field as it validates, flags failures with a reason and repairs them in place.

props.name: text
props.default: a finished invoice extraction with two issues
props.description: The JSON received so far. Partial JSON is expected: each value opens as its first character arrives and closes on its last (a number once something follows it).

props.name: status
props.description: The stream’s state. Required fields still missing when it is done are flagged; a stopped or interrupted stream marks them not received instead.

props.name: schema
props.description: Fields to validate, in rail order: path (dot path, [n] for items), label, type (string, number, integer, boolean, date, enum, array, object), required, options, pattern { source, message }, minItems, and check(value, get) for rules across fields.

props.name: schemaName
props.description: Shown in the toolbar after the source.

props.name: source
props.description: What the model is reading, such as the uploaded file’s name.

props.name: tokens
props.description: Tokens received; counts up in the toolbar. Estimated from the text when omitted.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Why the stream stopped, shown in the error banner when status is "error".

props.name: repairing
props.description: Paths the host is regenerating. Their rows read Repairing and skip validation until the path is cleared.

props.name: onRepair
props.description: Asks the model to fix failing fields: one from a row’s Repair button, all from the rail header. Omit it and no repair buttons render.

props.name: onStop
props.description: Shown as Stop while streaming.

props.name: onRegenerate
props.description: Runs the extraction again; also the Retry in the error banner and the Run button when idle.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Receives the finished JSON. Without it, Copy JSON writes to the clipboard.

props.name: showLineNumbers
props.description: Line numbers in the code gutter. Field status dots stay either way.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the caret, the field being written and the selected field’s band. Valid and invalid stay semantic green and red.

props.name: theme
props.description: Colour theme.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root element.

name: Voice Mode
description: A voice conversation surface: hairline rings that breathe with the mic, a transcript that settles word by word, clear turns, and a tap that cuts the reply mid-sentence.

props.name: state
props.description: Whose turn it is. The host drives it; the component never advances on its own. Interrupted shows the cut until the host reopens the mic.

props.name: turns
props.description: The conversation, oldest first. User turns carry committed text plus a dim interim tail; assistant turns carry the full reply, spoken (words voiced so far) and cutAt (where the user cut in).

props.name: name
props.description: The assistant’s name, in the header, the transcript and the button labels.

props.name: language
props.description: The recognition language, shown under the name.

props.name: transcript
props.description: Show the live transcript under the mark. Off, it folds away and the surface is the mark alone.

props.name: sensitivity
props.description: 0 to 100. Sets the noise gate from −20 dB (0) to −60 dB (100). The gate is drawn as a tick on the mic meter; only sound past it moves the mark.

props.name: mark
props.description: The level-reactive form around the button: four hairline rings that ripple outward, or three mirrored bars either side.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one colour, and it means the mic is open: listening rings, the button core, the live dot, the meter fill and the cut marker. The glyph on it picks black or white for contrast.

props.name: muted
props.description: Controlled mute. Pair with onMutedChange. Omit to let the Mute button own it.

props.name: defaultMuted
props.description: Starting mute state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onMutedChange
props.description: Called by the Mute button.

props.name: getLevel
props.description: The mic’s RMS amplitude, 0 to 1, sampled once a frame. Without it the mark runs a synthetic speech envelope while listening.

props.name: getOutputLevel
props.description: The assistant’s playback amplitude, 0 to 1, sampled once a frame while speaking. Synthetic when omitted.

props.name: onStart
props.description: Tap on the mark while idle or interrupted: open the mic.

props.name: onStop
props.description: Tap on the mark while listening: the user is done, send the turn.

props.name: onInterrupt
props.description: Tap on the mark while thinking or speaking: stop playback and set cutAt on the reply.

props.name: onEnd
props.description: The End button.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface palette.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root section.

name: Permission Policy Matrix
description: Edit role grants with their prerequisites visible, review the exact grant/remove plan and save a copied policy.
usage:
import { PermissionMatrix } from "@/components/design-for-ai/app-permission-matrix";

<PermissionMatrix />

props.name: title
props.description: Current work object in the compact header.

props.name: workspace
props.description: Workspace or store name in the app bar.

props.name: scope
props.description: Policy scope in the compact workspace bar.

props.name: roles
props.description: Unique role ids, names and descriptions; locked roles cannot be edited.

props.name: permissions
props.description: Unique permission ids/names/groups/descriptions and prerequisite ids. Missing dependencies, cycles and more than 100 permissions are rejected.

props.name: defaultGrants
props.description: Starting role-to-permission arrays. Unknown roles/permissions or missing prerequisites block saving. An exact accepted-policy echo preserves the save acknowledgement; a different policy starts a fresh draft and retires old replies.

props.name: onSave
props.description: Persist a copied policy. Resolve only after the host service applies it; reject to retain the edit plan. The component does not enforce server authorization.

props.name: theme
props.description: Neutral graphite or paper surfaces.

props.name: accent
props.description: Optional hex accent; defaults to theme ink and selects readable button text.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional outer component classes.

name: Recovery Codes
description: A two-factor recovery sheet: codes hide behind privacy glass, decode on reveal, copy, download and print with real feedback, and end on a saved confirmation.

props.name: codes
props.description: { code, usedAt? } as issued by your server. Used codes stay listed, struck through with their date, and are left out of every export. The component never generates codes.

props.name: account
props.description: Printed on the sheet and in the export header.

props.name: product
props.description: Product name in the body copy and the export header.

props.name: generatedAt
props.description: ISO date the set was issued, shown on the sheet.

props.name: defaultRevealed
props.description: Start with codes visible instead of behind the privacy glass.

props.name: fileName
props.description: File name for Download.

props.name: onCopy
props.description: Called after the unused codes reach the clipboard.

props.name: onDownload
props.description: Replaces the built-in .txt download. Reject to show the failed state.

props.name: onPrint
props.description: Replaces the built-in print sheet (a throwaway frame with only the codes).

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: The user ticked the box and pressed I’ve saved my codes. The button shows Saving while it runs; a rejection shows an inline error and keeps the box ticked.

props.name: onRegenerate
props.description: Issue a fresh set. When supplied, a Generate new codes action appears with a destructive confirm step; the new set decodes in and exports and the confirmation reset.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one colour: scrambling characters in the decode, export feedback and the success check.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black card with white ink, or a white card with near-black ink.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes on the card.

name: SSO-Aware Sign-in
description: A dark work-email sign-in that reads the domain as you type: the password folds away, the button becomes Continue with Okta, shared domains get a picker.

props.name: detect
props.description: Look a domain up. [] keeps email + password; one workspace morphs to SSO; several show the picker. Defaults to a lookup in `directory`.

props.name: directory
props.description: Static domain → workspaces map used when `detect` is not given. Demo domains: acme.com, globex.com, contoso.com, initech.io.

props.name: debounceMs
props.description: Quiet time after the last keystroke before the domain is checked.

props.name: onSsoContinue
props.description: Start the redirect. The button shows redirect progress until it resolves; reject with an Error to show its message.

props.name: onPasswordSignIn
props.description: Password sign-in for non-SSO domains. Reject with an Error to show it under the password field.

props.name: email
props.description: Controlled email value. Pair with onEmailChange, or use defaultEmail.

props.name: defaultEmail
props.description: Initial email when uncontrolled.

props.name: onEmailChange
props.description: Called on every edit.

props.name: onForgotPassword
props.description: The “Forgot?” link.

props.name: brand
props.description: Product name beside the mark.

props.name: title
props.description: Card heading.

props.name: description
props.description: One line under the heading.

props.name: signUpHref
props.description: Target of the “Start a free trial” link.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the primary button and the selected workspace ring and dot. Provider marks keep their brand colours.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface palette. The light theme keeps the original warm-grey paper look.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root.

controls.label: Subheading
controls.default: Use your work email. If your company signs in with SSO, we’ll send you the right way.

name: Live Bento Grid
description: A hairline bento grid for an analytics product: six live tiles in black and white, from a self-drawing chart to a dot-map, staggering in with counting figures.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black surfaces with white ink, or warm paper with near-black ink. The stat tile always inverts; the map tile sinks to the darkest surface.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one signal colour: the chart’s “now” dot, the heatmap peak, live cities and the answer’s latest bar.

props.name: ambient
props.description: Ambient motion: the metric cycle, typing, switch flips and live cities. Off leaves a still grid; entrances and clicks still work.

props.name: heading
props.description: Optional section header. Omit it (the default) and the grid stands on its own.

props.name: headingMuted
props.description: Second clause of the heading at 60% ink.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Mono label above the heading.

props.name: intro
props.description: Paragraph beside the heading.

props.name: link
props.description: Underlined link under the intro.

props.name: trend
props.description: Line-chart tile. The line draws in, then morphs between metrics every 4.2s (holding while a pointer is over the tile) until someone picks one; each new total counts up.

props.name: stat
props.description: Inverted tile: one number that counts up out of a blur, then two meters that fill.

props.name: heatmap
props.description: Weekday × hour heatmap. Cells fill in a single diagonal entrance, then remain stable with the labeled peak highlighted.

props.name: search
props.description: Search tile that types each question and then shows its answer.

props.name: alerts
props.description: Settings card of real switches that flip themselves until touched; the preview message follows the watched switch.

props.name: map
props.description: Deep tile: a dot-matrix world that sweeps in west to east, pulsing cities, a live total and the top four cities.

props.name: children
props.description: Compose your own grid from the exported tiles (TrendTile, StatTile, HeatmapTile, SearchTile, AlertsTile, MapTile) instead of the default six.

name: Dither Flow
description: A slowly advecting noise field rendered as an ordered Bayer 8×8 dither in two inks, like a risograph in motion. The pointer leaves a short wake of ink behind it.
usage:
import { BgDitherFlow } from "@/components/design-for-ai/bg-dither-flow";

Print, in motion.
// Children sit above the field, inside the quiet zone at the centre.

props.name: pixelSize
props.description: Dither cell size in CSS pixels, 1 to 8. Larger cells read as a coarser print.

props.name: threshold
props.description: Where the ink cut sits, 0 to 1. Lower floods the field with ink; higher leaves almost none.

props.name: quiet
props.description: How far the centre of the stage is held to paper, 0 to 1, so a headline sits on calm ground.

props.name: inkA
props.description: The dense ink, drawn where the field is heaviest. Light on dark paper, dark on light paper. Neutral by default.

props.name: inkB
props.description: The paper ink, drawn everywhere else. Also the root background, so an invalid value never shows a seam.

props.name: speed
props.description: Drift speed multiplier, 0 to 2. 0 holds the field still and stops the loop.

props.name: wake
props.description: Leave a short wake of ink behind the pointer. Off ignores the pointer entirely.

props.name: children
props.description: Content drawn above the field, such as a headline or a caption. Sits in the quiet zone at the centre.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which fills its parent. Give the parent a height.

name: Fluted Glass
description: Ribbed-glass refraction over your own image: SVG displacement that forms on load, honest ridge light and crisp foreground content on top.

props.name: scene
props.description: The image behind the glass: { src, description? }. Its real load and decode drive loading, ready and error.

props.name: children
props.description: Foreground content. It is never filtered, scaled or clipped, and its menus can overflow.

props.name: strength
props.description: Displacement in CSS pixels, 0–32. Changes tween in 240ms; on first load the ridges form over 900ms.

props.name: frost
props.description: Gaussian frost in CSS pixels, 0–2.5.

props.name: flutes
props.description: Number of ridges across the surface, 8–40.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Vertical flutes bend sideways; horizontal flutes bend up and down.

props.name: quality
props.description: Render budget for the filtered layer: standard 640k or high 1.28M layout pixels, then scaled to fit.

props.name: radius
props.description: Background corner radius, 0–64px. Foreground overflow is kept.

props.name: theme
props.description: Colours for the well and the loading/error strip.

props.name: onSceneStateChange
props.description: Reports the image's status and natural size once decoded.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, such as a height.

name: Grain Light Field
description: A WebGL shaft of light falling across near-black, with fine film grain and one accent pooled in a corner. It leans toward the pointer and rests under reduced motion.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent, pooled in the bottom-right corner and kept there. Set accentAmount to 0 to turn it off.

props.name: accentAmount
props.description: How much of the accent pool shows, 0 to 1. At 0 the field is monochrome: light and ink only.

props.name: intensity
props.description: Brightness of the falling light, 0 to 1. It also scales the accent pool.

props.name: grain
props.description: Film grain strength, 0 to 1. The grain is a noise layer over the light, so it stays fine at every size.

props.name: speed
props.description: Drift and grain rate. 1 is the default pace; 0 holds the light and the grain still.

props.name: followPointer
props.description: Lean the light a little toward the mouse or pen. Touch never moves it, so a drag still scrolls the page.

props.name: paused
props.description: Freeze the light, its lean and the grain on the current frame.

props.name: children
props.description: Content layered over the field. The field sits behind it and never receives its layout.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root element, which fills its parent.

name: Topographic Contours
description: A full-bleed relief of contour lines traced from a real height field: levels flow slowly uphill, the light swings to the pointer and a raking spotlight follows it.

props.name: field
props.type: { columns: number; rows: number; values: number[] }
props.description: Height samples row by row, in any unit. Upsampled bicubically before tracing, so a 32 × 24 grid still draws smooth lines. A malformed field leaves a plain surface; a flat one has no contours.

props.name: children
props.description: Content over the background. It stays crisp DOM and keeps its own events.

props.name: density
props.description: Contour levels, 4–32. Changes glide: lines part or close up instead of popping.

props.name: lightAngle
props.description: Light bearing in degrees when the pointer isn't steering it. Each line carries a lit and a shadowed edge from it.

props.name: drift
props.description: How fast the levels flow uphill, 0–1. 0 holds the surface still. The one ambient motion; it stops offscreen, in hidden tabs and under reduced motion.

props.name: followPointer
props.description: The light swings toward the pointer and a raking spotlight lifts the lines near it.

props.name: indexEvery
props.description: Every nth line is an index contour, drawn heavier. Index lines keep their identity as the levels flow. 0 turns it off.

props.name: onProbe
props.type: (probe: { x: number; y: number; value: number } | null) => void
props.description: The field's value under the pointer, in its own unit, with the position as 0–1 fractions. null when the pointer leaves.

props.name: quality
props.description: Canvas pixel budget: 0.64 or 1.28 megapixels. Device pixel ratio is capped at 2.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius in px, 0–64. Clips the canvas only.

props.name: accent
props.description: Colour of the spotlight on the lines near the pointer.

props.name: theme
props.description: Graphite ground with pale lines, or paper with ink lines.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes on the root. Give it a height (min-h-dvh, h-[480px]); the canvas covers it.

name: Honest Cancel Flow
description: A cancellation flow that answers each reason with an honest alternative (pause, downgrade, export), then a dated what-happens-now timeline and a calm hold-to-cancel.

props.name: planName
props.description: The plan being cancelled, as named in the headings, the hold button and the summary.

props.name: reasons
props.type: { id: string; label: string; offer: CancelOffer }[]
props.description: Each reason and the alternative it opens: { kind: "pause", months } | { kind: "downgrade", planName } | { kind: "export", size } | { kind: "feedback", placeholder } | { kind: "none" }, each with a title and body.

props.name: defaultReason
props.description: The reason selected on mount, by id. Anything that isn't a reason id means none is selected.

props.name: step
props.description: Controlled step. Update it from onStepChange. Leave it out and the flow keeps its own.

props.name: onStepChange
props.description: Called when the flow moves to another step.

props.name: today
props.description: Today, ISO date. Pause offers count their months from it.

props.name: accessUntil
props.description: The last day of paid access, ISO date.

props.name: lastChargeDate
props.description: When the last invoice was paid, ISO date.

props.name: lastChargeAmount
props.description: What the last invoice charged.

props.name: retentionDays
props.description: Days data is kept after access ends. The deletion date on the timeline is accessUntil plus this.

props.name: email
props.description: Where reminders go, as printed in the timeline and the summary.

props.name: holdMs
props.description: How long the cancel button has to be held. The button shows the time; a release drains the fill back.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for dates and money.

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO 4217 code for the last charge.

props.name: onCancel
props.description: Called when the hold completes, with the reason and any note typed into the feedback offer.

props.name: onAcceptOffer
props.description: Called when the pause or downgrade offer is taken instead.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the selected reason and the offer's action. Cancelling itself stays in ink.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface and ink.

name: Billing Overview
description: One billing home: the plan and its price, a usage meter near its limit, the card on file and recent invoices, each opening in place.
usage:
import { BillingOverview } from "@/components/design-for-ai/billing-overview";

<BillingOverview
  workspace="Copperline"
  planName="Studio"
  seats={8}
  pricePerSeat={16}
  periodStart="2026-09-24"
  periodEnd="2026-10-23"
  today="2026-10-10"
  last4="4242"
  expiry="08/28"
  cardholder="Ines Varga"
  onOpenChange={(open) => console.log(open)}
/>

props.name: workspace
props.description: The workspace the bill belongs to, used as the heading and printed on the card.

props.name: planName
props.description: The current plan, named in the subtitle and the plan row.

props.name: seats
props.description: Seats on the plan. The monthly price is this times pricePerSeat.

props.name: pricePerSeat
props.description: Price per seat per month.

props.name: periodStart
props.description: First day of the current period, ISO date.

props.name: periodEnd
props.description: Last day of the current period, ISO date, inclusive. Renewal is the next day.

props.name: today
props.description: The day the home is being read, ISO date. Pass the real date in production.

props.name: meters
props.type: { id: string; label: string; used: number; limit: number; unit?: string }[]
props.description: Usage this period. The row shows the meter closest to its cap; opening lists every meter.

props.name: invoices
props.type: { id: string; date: string; amount: number }[]
props.description: Issued invoices, newest first once sorted. The row shows the latest; opening lists them.

props.name: last4
props.description: Last four digits of the card on file.

props.name: expiry
props.description: Expiry as printed, already formatted.

props.name: cardholder
props.description: Name printed on the card when the payment row is open.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for money, dates and meter figures.

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO 4217 code.

props.name: open
props.description: Which row is open. Pass it with onOpenChange to control the home; omit it and the home keeps its own state.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when a row is opened or closed. Closing the open row reports "none".

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the meter nearest its limit, that meter's figure, and the near-limit note.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface and ink. Light deepens the accent for text so it stays readable. The card stays a dark object in both.

name: Plan Change Proration
description: A plan switcher that prints the proration as a receipt before you confirm: unused credit, new charge, due today and the next invoice, over a strip of the period.

props.name: plans
props.type: { id: string; name: string; blurb: string; monthly: number; yearly: number }[]
props.description: The plans to choose between. Prices are per seat: per month when billed monthly, per year when billed yearly.

props.name: currentPlanId
props.description: The plan the workspace is on now. It carries a Current tag and is the source of the credit line.

props.name: currentInterval
props.description: How the current plan is billed.

props.name: defaultPlanId
props.description: The plan selected on mount. Picking the current plan (with the current interval) keeps the next invoice on the receipt; a different plan or interval prints the proration.

props.name: defaultInterval
props.description: The interval the toggle opens on. A new interval starts a fresh period today and charges the new plan in full.

props.name: seats
props.description: Seats on the subscription. Every price and line on the receipt scales with it.

props.name: periodStart
props.description: First day of the current period, ISO date.

props.name: periodEnd
props.description: Last day of the current period, ISO date, inclusive.

props.name: today
props.description: The day the change takes effect, ISO date. Pass the real date in production.

props.name: paymentLabel
props.description: The card that pays, as printed in the fine print and the confirmation.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for money and dates.

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO 4217 code.

props.name: yearlyBadge
props.description: The saving shown beside Yearly on the toggle. Empty hides it.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Called with the quote the receipt showed. Return a promise to hold the loading state; reject it to show the declined state. Defaults to a 900ms fake.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the selection ring, the new plan's stretch of the period and the confirm button.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface and ink. Light deepens the accent for text so it stays readable.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Shown when required data is unavailable. The empty state has no confirm or playback action.

name: Seat Manager
description: A seat stepper whose monthly bill counts as you add or remove seats, with invited emails flying into a pending list and a warning when an invite has no spare seat.

props.name: planName
props.description: The plan the seats belong to, named in the heading and the status line.

props.name: pricePerSeat
props.description: Price per seat per month. The monthly total, the delta and the prorated due-today all scale with it.

props.name: billedSeats
props.description: Seats the workspace is already paying for. The delta is the stepper minus this.

props.name: defaultSeats
props.description: Where the stepper opens. Read on mount.

props.name: members
props.type: { id: string; name: string; email: string; role: string }[]
props.description: People who already hold a seat. The stepper cannot go below this count, and their emails cannot be invited again.

props.name: periodStart
props.description: First day of the current period, ISO date.

props.name: periodEnd

name: Gravity Grid
description: A tile grid that bends toward the cursor like spacetime around a mass, its slope catching light, while a click sends a shockwave ring through the tiles.
usage:
import { GravityGrid } from "@/components/design-for-ai/effect-gravity-grid"; // Fills its parent; give the parent a height. Content inside sits above the field.

Weight, made visible.
// Fire a shockwave from the centre from outside the field. track("pulse", { x, y })} accent="#8ab4ff" />

props.name: cell
props.description: Tile pitch in CSS px, clamped to 14–64. The lattice gets one tile of overscan on every side, so the well never drags an edge into view.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between tiles in px. Tiles are inset toward their own centre, so the gap stretches and shrinks with the warp.

props.name: pull
props.description: How hard the mass pulls, 0 to 1. Internally capped below the point where a Gaussian well would fold tiles over each other.

props.name: radius
props.description: Reach of the well in px (the Gaussian's sigma is half of it). Capped at 45% of the field's shorter side, so a small field keeps a proportionate well.

props.name: shockwave
props.description: A click, a tap or Enter sends a shockwave ring out from the point. Off, the field only bends.

props.name: rest
props.description: Where the mass rests while the pointer is away. centre settles into a gentle well (62% strength) in the middle, so the field shows its idea at rest; none lets it go flat. Either way the loop sleeps once settled.

props.name: accent
props.description: Tint of the shockwave front, as a hex colour.

props.name: theme
props.description: White tiles on #070708, or ink tiles on #f3f2ee paper.

props.name: children
props.description: Content drawn above the field. It lets the pointer through, except links and buttons.

props.name: onPulse
props.description: Called with the point (px from the field's top left) each time a shockwave starts.

props.name: pulseKey
props.description: Change it to send a shockwave from the centre, e.g. from a button outside the field.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root, which fills its parent.

name: Budget Variance

props.name: departments

props.name: period
props.description: Period label for the toolbar, totals and the receipt.

props.name: reviewer

props.description: Author recorded on notes written here.

props.name: today

props.name: largeThresholdMinor

props.name: scope

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO 4217 code. Amounts are minor units of this currency.

props.name: locale

props.name: accent

props.name: theme

props.name: className

name: Month-End Close

props.name: onSignOff

props.name: theme

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root.

name: Expense Review

name: Invoice Composer

props.name: defaultMessage

props.name: notes

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO 4217 code. Amounts are minor units of this currency.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for money and dates.

props.description: Persist the draft with its computed subtotal, discount, tax and total. Reject to keep it and show the message.

props.description: Issue and email the invoice. Resolve (optionally with { paymentUrl }) to stamp it sent and show the receipt; reject to keep the draft and show why. The receipt shows only a returned paymentUrl and omits the payment-link controls when none is returned.

props.name: account

name: Receivables Aging
description: Accounts receivable as one stacked aging bar you click into, customers ranked by their oldest debt, and a reminder you write, tone and send in place.

props.description: Open invoices: { id, customerId, dueDate (YYYY-MM-DD), amountMinor, paidMinor? }. Fully paid invoices are ignored. Invalid due dates and unknown customer references are reported and excluded from totals until corrected.

props.name: customers

props.name: referenceDate
props.description: ISO date the ledger is aged to. Buckets are not yet due, 1–30, 31–60, 61–90 and over 90 days late.

props.description: ISO 4217 code. Amounts are minor units of this currency.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for money and dates.

props.description: Receives { customerId, invoiceIds, outstandingMinor, tone, to, subject, message }. Resolve to show the receipt and mark the customer as just contacted; reject to keep the draft and show the error message.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: selection rail, tone pill and the primary action. Defaults to the theme’s ink.

props.name: theme

name: Bank Reconciliation
description: Bank lines on one side, the books on the other: matches draw across, the difference counts to zero and Balanced lands. Scored auto-match suggestions.

props.name: account
props.description: The account being reconciled: { name, mask, statementBalanceMinor, ledgerBalanceMinor }. Both balances are minor units; the books balance moves as rule entries are booked.

props.name: period
props.description: Period label for the toolbar and the receipt.

props.name: statement
props.description: Bank lines: { id, date (ISO), description, amountMinor (signed: in positive, out negative), rule? }. A line with a rule ({ account, label }) offers to book itself to that account.

props.name: ledger
props.description: Entries in the books: { id, date, description, reference?, account?, amountMinor }. Entries still unmatched once the statement is fully matched are shown as not cleared.

props.name: defaultMatches
props.description: Pairs matched on first render: { statementId, ledgerIds, source? }. Pairs naming missing rows or reusing a ledger entry are dropped.

props.name: suggestions
props.description: Your matching engine’s proposals: { statementId, ledgerIds, confidence (0–1), reason }. Leave out to use the built-in matcher (equal amounts, lifted by shared reference, payee and close dates; two-entry splits from one payee).

props.name: autoMatchThreshold
props.description: Confidence Auto-match accepts without review. Lower suggestions stay as amber chips to accept one by one.

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO 4217 code. Amounts are minor units of this currency.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for money and dates.

props.name: onMatch
props.description: Saves a match { statementId, ledgerIds, source: "suggested" | "manual" | "booked" }. Reject to retract the line and keep the selection; the message is shown with Try again.

props.name: onUnmatch
props.description: Removes a match. Reject to put it back.

props.name: onBook

props.name: scenarios

props.description: Choosing an option moves on after a short beat.

props.name: noun

props.name: prefix
props.description: Written before each figure.

props.name: suffix
props.description: Written after each figure, such as " min" or "%".

props.name: openEnded
props.description: Show the maximum as open ended (“$600+”) for data that runs past the scale.

props.name: locale
props.description: Number formatting locale.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the interval but takes no input.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the selected band, its lit bars and the thumb halo.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black card with white ink, or the white inverse.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the card.

name: Formula Editor
description: A formula bar for computed columns: field chips, live syntax colour, autocomplete, wavy error underlines with one-click fixes and a preview that recounts.

props.name: title
props.description: The computed column's name, shown in the tool bar.

props.name: table
props.description: The table the column belongs to.

props.name: fields
props.description: Fields a formula can use: { id, label, kind: number | text | boolean, format?: currency | percent | number }.

props.name: rows
props.description: Sample rows the formula previews against: { id, label, values }. Click a row to show its values in the field list.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled saved formula. Pair with onValueChange.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Uncontrolled starting formula.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Save request from Save or ⌘↵, only for a formula that checks. Return a promise to show Saving…; a rejection keeps the draft.

props.name: resultFormat
props.description: How number results display in the preview and total.

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO 4217 code for currency results and fields.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for numbers.

props.name: resetKey
props.description: Change it to discard the draft.

props.name: status
props.description: Sample-row availability. Loading shows skeleton rows; error shows a message and Try again. The formula stays editable only when ready.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Text for the preview error.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Shows Try again in the preview error.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Read only: the formula and preview stay visible.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface the editor sits on.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: numbers in the formula, the caret, the result column and the selected row.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root section.

name: Ruler Unit Converter
description: A measuring input: a big reading that morphs between units, a tape you drag or fling under a fixed line, unit chips with a travelling pill and typed entry.

props.name: label
props.description: What is being measured. Heads the card and names the reading, the field and the ruler.

props.name: hint
props.default: "White oak worktop · stock runs to 4.2 m"
props.description: One quiet line beside the label.

props.name: units
props.description: Display units: { id, label, symbol, factor, offset? }. A figure is base × factor + offset, so affine scales such as °F work.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled quantity in base units plus the unit it is shown in. Pair with onValueChange.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Starting quantity when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called on every change: a unit switch (base untouched), a typed value, a tap, a key step, and each frame of a drag or fling.

props.name: precision
props.description: Most decimal places a figure shows. A figure that had to round is marked ≈.

props.name: minBase
props.description: Lower bound in base units. The tape dims past it and a typed value outside it is refused with the range.

props.name: maxBase
props.description: Upper bound in base units.

props.name: span
props.description: Base units visible across the ruler. Smaller zooms the tape in; marks re-space to stay readable.

props.name: locale
props.description: Number formatting locale for the figures.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Shows the reading but takes no input.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the reading line and the measured stretch of tape behind it.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black card with white ink, or the white inverse.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the card.

name: Split Resizer
description: Two panes and a divider that feels physical: it snaps to marks, resists at the limits, folds a pane into a rail with a spring, and shows both sizes as you drag.

props.name: primary
props.description: First pane (left, or top when stacked). It stays mounted when folded, so drafts and scroll survive.

props.name: secondary
props.description: Second pane. Also stays mounted when folded.

props.name: primaryLabel
props.description: Names the pane for its rail, the size readout and screen readers.

props.name: secondaryLabel
props.description: Names the second pane.

props.name: primaryIcon
props.description: Icon on the primary pane's rail when folded.

props.name: secondaryIcon
props.description: Icon on the secondary pane's rail when folded.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled size of the primary pane, in percent. 0 folds it into a rail; 100 folds the secondary. If you don't accept a change, the divider springs back.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial split when uncontrolled; double-clicking the divider returns to it.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called once a drag, key, fold or restore settles (not on every pointer move).

props.name: snapPoints
props.description: Percentages the divider is pulled onto while dragging; PageUp/PageDown step between them.

props.name: snapDistance
props.description: How close (px) the divider has to come to a snap point to be pulled onto it.

props.name: minPrimary
props.description: Smallest open size of the primary pane in px. Dragging past it resists, then folds.

props.name: minSecondary
props.description: Smallest open size of the secondary pane in px.

props.name: collapsible
props.description: Which panes can fold into a 44px rail.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Auto stacks the panes below autoBreakpoint of container width.

props.name: autoBreakpoint
props.description: Container width (px) below which auto stacks.

props.name: keyboardStep
props.description: Arrow-key step in px; Shift moves four times as far.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Locks the divider. The panes stay fully usable.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the split in px.

props.name: accent
props.description: Colour of the divider while dragging and of the snap mark it sits on.

props.name: theme
props.description: Frame palette.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root.

name: Clause Library
description: A clause library that sets approved wording as real contract paragraphs, redlines revisions and flies the chosen clause into the open section of a draft agreement.

props.name: clauses
props.description: Library clauses with id, title, category, usage count, playbook guidance and revisions (newest first: version, approved | draft | retired, approver, ISO date, wording with sub-clauses split by a blank line).

props.name: terms
props.description: Defined terms of the agreement ({ term, definition }). Matches in the wording are underlined and explain themselves on hover, focus or tap.

props.name: document
props.description: The agreement being drafted: title, parties, reference and numbered sections. A section without text is an open insertion point; `requires` names the playbook clause it expects.

props.name: defaultClauseId
props.description: Clause opened first. Defaults to the first clause.

props.name: defaultShowChanges
props.description: Start with the redline against the previous revision showing.

props.name: onInsert
props.description: Writes the approved revision into the target section ({ clauseId, version, text, sectionId, number }). Resolve to fly the clause into the draft; reject to keep the selection and offer a retry.

props.name: onUndo
props.description: Removes the last inserted clause. A rejection puts the clause back and says so.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: selection bar, defined terms, the open section and the landing highlight.

props.name: theme
props.description: Graphite chrome with a paper draft, or the light inverse.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root.

name: Document Request Checklist
description: A client document checklist: attach a file or an inbox match to each request, submit it, and watch it land in the received tray as a paper card with a stamp.

props.name: title
props.description: Entity name in the header.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Matter or client context, shown as a breadcrumb (split on “ · ”).

props.name: requests
props.description: Requests with id, title, description, requestedBy, dueLabel and optional ISO due, state (awaiting | received | accepted | revision-needed), lowercase dot-prefixed allowedExtensions, maxBytes, reviewNote, the received file and an optional inbox suggestion ({ id, name, bytes, from, receivedLabel }).

props.name: onUpload
props.description: Receives { requestId, file } for a chosen or dropped File, or { requestId, attachment } for an inbox match. Resolve once receipt is acknowledged to stamp it; reject to keep the file attached and offer a retry. Validate type, size and access again on the server.

props.name: referenceDate
props.description: ISO date treated as today for due countdowns. Defaults to the current date.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the open request, the received stamp and the progress ring.

props.name: theme
props.description: Graphite chrome with paper documents, or the light inverse.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root.

name: Evidence Index
description: An exhibit binder: tabbed index, paper cover sheets with sticker, Bates range and SHA-256, a custody trail that draws and flags a broken hash, and a stamped export.

props.name: exhibits
props.description: Exhibits with id, tab label, title, kind, source, ISO receivedAt, intake sha256, bytes, pages, Bates range and custody hand-offs ({ id, at, actor, role, action, sha256 }). A hand-off hash that differs from intake breaks the chain. Without recorded hand-off hashes the chain is unverified and excluded from the intact count.

props.name: matter
props.description: Case caption, claim reference and bundle name, printed on every cover sheet and in the header.

props.name: defaultExhibitId
props.description: Exhibit opened first. Defaults to the first exhibit.

props.name: defaultIncluded
props.description: Exhibit ids in the manifest to start with.

props.name: onExport
props.description: Exports { exhibits: { id, label, title, sha256, bytes, bates, broken, verified }[] }. Resolve to stamp the manifest; reject to keep the selection and offer a retry. Files themselves are never fetched or hashed here. broken flags a changed hash; verified is true only when at least one recorded hash was compared and all matched.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the exhibit sticker, the selected tab mark and the exported stamp.
