props.name: legs
props.description: Legs in travel order with unique nonempty ids, valid offset ISO instants, IANA time zones and finite coordinates. Both scheduled and revised arrivals must follow departure. Invalid or duplicate legs are excluded with a notice. Key the component by trip or booking revision when replacing its dataset.

props.name: now
props.description: ISO instant that decides the next leg and where you are on the map. Defaults to the device clock.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for local clocks, zone names and day headers.

props.name: tightConnection
props.description: Connections shorter than this many minutes are flagged in amber.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one hue: your position on the route and the drawn timeline line.

props.name: defaultTab
props.description: Tab shown first.

props.name: onOpenLeg
props.description: Opens the booking and resolves only after it opens. Missing handlers omit the booking action. Failures retain the leg details for retry; Cancel or opening another leg aborts the previous signal and ignores late completion.

props.name: onBack

name: Voice Memo
description: A dark React Native voice memo: drag the waveform under a fixed playhead to scrub, a transcript that lights word by word, markers and a glass transport.

props.name: recording
props.description: Recording identity, labels, finite positive duration in seconds, evenly spaced peaks (0–1), markers and ordered transcript segments. props.name: initialPosition
props.description: Initial seconds, clamped to the recording. Non-finite values start at zero. The playhead glides there on first view.

props.name: autoPlay
props.description: Start playing once the entrance has settled.

props.name: initialRate
props.description: Starting playback speed. The chip cycles 1×, 1.5×, 2×, 0.75×; unsupported runtime values fall back to 1×.

props.name: accent
props.description: Colour of the playhead and current transcript word. Dark, translucent or invalid colours fall back to white for contrast.

props.name: onPlayingChange
props.description: Play, pause, autoplay start and recording completion, with the current position. Mirror this synchronous notification into your audio engine; the component only animates its visual playhead.

props.name: onSeek
props.description: A scrub, waveform tap, transcript line, marker or skip landed on this second.

props.name: onRateChange
props.description: The speed chip changed the playback rate.

props.name: onMarkerAdd
props.description: The flag button dropped a marker at the playhead.

props.name: onBack
props.description: Back chevron in the header. Disabled when omitted.

props.name: onShare
props.description: Share the recording through the host. The share action is disabled when this callback is absent.

name: Wallet Card Stack
description: A React Native wallet of engraved cards drawn in code on a neutral dark stage: they deal in, a tapped card lifts to the top and its balance and activity count in.

props.name: cards
props.description: Cards and passes: issuer, label, peek field, kind, pattern (guilloche | contour | rings | halftone | brushed), face colours (3–4 gradient stops, ink, accent), figure, meta and transactions. Card faces are the only colour on screen.

props.name: maxCards
props.description: Show only the first n cards; the stack re-spaces itself and a card that is no longer shown closes. Defaults to all of them.

props.name: activeId
props.description: Holds a card open by id so a host can drive the stack. Any other value, or null, returns to the stack. Changes after mount move it; leave it out and the visitor opens cards by tapping.

props.name: title
props.description: Large title. A long one stays on one line beside the add button, shrinking to fit before it truncates.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: Line under the title. Defaults to a count of the cards shown.

props.name: summary
props.description: Collapsed-state month summary: label, value (a number that counts up, with prefix and decimals), note, daily bar heights (0–1, last is today) and a day letter per bar.

props.name: onAdd
props.description: Fired from the glass add menu.

props.name: onOpenCard
props.description: Fired when a card lifts out of the stack.

props.name: onSeeAll
props.description: Fired by See all in the detail view.

name: Multi-select Chips
description: A multi-select where each pick's code badge flies from its row into the field as a chip, with a tri-state select-all, grouped search, Backspace removal and a +3 fold.

props.name: label
props.description: Mono label above the field, and the accessible name of the list.

props.name: options
props.type: { id: string; label: string; code: string; group?: string; meta?: string }[]
props.description: The options. `code` is the mono badge that flies into the field; `group` feeds the headings; `meta` is a mono note on the right of the row.

props.name: defaultSelected

props.name: onChange

props.name: maxVisibleChips
props.description: Chips shown before older picks fold into a "+N" counter at the front of the field. The newest picks stay visible; the counter expands and folds them.

props.name: selectAll
props.description: A tri-state row (off, mixed, on) that selects or clears every option the list is showing, including just the matches of a search.

props.name: searchable
props.description: Type to filter by name or code. Off, the field is a picker: no caret, a globe icon, and Backspace still drops the last chip.

props.name: grouped
props.description: Mono group headings over the options, in the order groups first appear.

props.name: size
props.description: Density of the field, chips, rows and checkboxes: 42px or 52px field.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Field placeholder while searchable.

props.name: pickerPlaceholder
props.description: Field placeholder while not searchable and nothing is picked.

props.name: noun
props.description: What one option is called, singular then plural. Used in the select-all row, the empty state and announcements.

props.name: metaLabel
props.description: Mono note over the meta column, on the first group heading.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Open the list on first render. The demo opens it.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: filled checkboxes. Chips, badges and rows stay greyscale.

props.name: accentInk
props.description: The tick and the dash on the accent. Dark ink for a light accent, light ink for a dark one.

props.name: theme
props.description: Greyscale palette for the field, chips and sheet.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root.

name: Context Rail
description: An icon rail with a contextual list: selection travels, lists cross-fade by direction, each section remembers its place, and it folds to a drawer when narrow.

props.name: sections
props.description: Sections with id, label, icon, optional badge count and items. Items take id, label, optional meta (trailing count or date), detail (second line), group (small heading), icon, and disabled with a disabledReason. Duplicate ids are dropped.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the icon rail.

props.name: brand
props.description: Workspace name; its initial is the rail’s mark.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled { sectionId, itemId }. The rail follows it and remembers it for that section.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial uncontrolled selection. Defaults to the first enabled item.

props.name: onValueChange

props.name: defaultCollapsed

props.name: onCollapsedChange
props.description: Reports folding in the docked layout.

props.name: status
props.description: Host data state: skeleton rows while loading, an alert with Try again on error.

props.name: errorMessage

props.description: Body of the error state.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Shown as Try again in the error state.

props.name: theme
props.description: Neutral palette.

props.name: density
props.description: 40px or 36px rows (44px on touch either way).

props.name: accent
props.description: The rail indicator, badges and the selected row’s tick.

props.name: children
props.description: The host’s content area. The list docks beside it at 640px and wider, and becomes a drawer over it below.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes on the root.

name: Lens Dock
description: A macOS-grade app dock: tiles swell smoothly under the pointer, a glass lens rides over them, names float above, with keyboard, touch scrubbing and async opens.

props.name: items
props.default: Home, Inbox, Calendar, Notes, Files, Focus (disabled), Settings
props.description: Unique id, label and icon (any ReactNode). Optional tile material (light, dark, paper), badge, running dot, a divider before it (separated), and disabled with a reason that becomes its label.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the navigation.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled current item (aria-current). Update it once onActivate resolves.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial uncontrolled current item.

props.name: onActivate
props.type: (id: string, item: LensDockItem, signal: AbortSignal) => void | Promise<void>
props.description: Opens an item. A returned promise shows a spinner under the tile; a rejection shakes it and offers Retry. The signal aborts when another item is chosen or the dock unmounts; stale completions are ignored.

props.name: magnification
props.description: Peak scale under the pointer, 1 to 2.2, with a cosine falloff over 2.6 tiles. Eased off automatically when the container is too narrow; off with reduced motion.

props.name: size
props.description: Resting tile size in px. Shrinks to fit (down to 36px); below that the row scrolls.

props.name: labels
props.description: Floating names above the hovered, focused or touched tile.

props.name: lens
props.description: The glass lens that rides with the pointer over the swelling tiles.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Locks every item; names and reasons still show.

props.name: accent
props.description: Badges and the calendar weekday.

props.name: theme
props.description: Frosted graphite or frosted white plate, labels and lens.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes on the measured outer container.

name: Stacked Document Tabs
description: Document tabs that behave like paper: drag one and its neighbours shuffle aside, close with Undo, unsaved dots that become a close button, drafts kept.

props.name: items
props.description: { id, label, kind?: "doc" | "sheet" | "code", dirty?, disabled?, disabledReason?, revision?, content? }. Authoritative: removing an item retires its tab, history and retained editor. Content mounts on first open and then stays mounted, including while closed.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the tab list.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled selected id. Falls back to the first available document.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Selected id when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when a tab is selected, including the neighbour picked after a close.

props.name: onCloseRequest
props.description: Ask the host to close. Dirty documents confirm first. A pending close shows a spinner with Cancel; a rejection keeps the tab and its draft and offers Retry.

props.name: onRestoreRequest
props.description: Ask the host to reopen a closed document (History button or Undo). It returns to its old position with its draft.

props.name: onOrderChange
props.description: Called after a drag or a keyboard move. Rejecting puts the previous order back.

props.name: resetKey
props.description: Change it for a new workspace or account: clears order, history and retained editors.

props.name: tabWidth
props.description: Tab width in px (120–260).

props.name: panelHeight
props.description: Height of the document area in px (220–720).

props.name: accent
props.description: Unsaved dot and the move-mode ring.

props.name: theme
props.description: Palette.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root.

name: Halftone Image
description: An image becomes a live halftone screen: drag the divide against the original, tune dot size, threshold, angle and shape, and export a crisp PNG.

props.name: source
props.default: A still life drawn in SVG
props.description: id, src, alt and optional title. Remote images must send CORS headers so their pixels can be read; without them the stage shows a designed error.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled settings: cell (dot pitch, 5–28 px), threshold (0–0.6), angle (0–90°) and shape ("dot" | "square" | "line"). Out-of-range values are clamped.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial settings when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Runs with the complete settings whenever a slider or the shape changes.

props.name: onExport
props.description: Receives the PNG blob, its pixel size, the source id and the settings. Throw to show your error; changing settings aborts the signal. A download link appears either way.

props.name: defaultSplit
props.description: Where the original/halftone divide starts, 0–1 from the left. 0 shows only the halftone.

props.name: exportScale
props.description: Export resolution as a multiple of the on-screen size, redrawn rather than upscaled. The longest side is capped at 4096 px.

props.name: ink
props.description: Dot colour. Defaults to warm white on dark paper and near-black on light paper.

props.name: status
props.description: Host availability of the source; loading shows a dot skeleton, error a designed message.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: Explanation shown with status error.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Locks settings and export; the image and the divide stay usable.

props.name: theme
props.description: Dark paper with light ink, or paper-white with dark ink.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes on the root section.

props.name: projects

props.name: defaultProject

props.description: Called with the option id when a ticket is chosen.

props.description: The primary action. Return a promise to hold the pending state; reject it to show a recoverable failure. Without it the button is disabled.

props.description: Renders Try again in the error state.

props.name: onRevoke

props.description: Contour interval in metres; every fifth line is an index contour.

props.name: lineColor
props.description: Minor contour colour, drawn at 46%. Neutral white by default.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: index contours, pin ripples, pin labels and the legend swatch.

props.name: speed
props.description: Drift speed multiplier; 0 holds the map still.

props.name: maxPins
props.description: Pins kept at once (up to 7); the oldest sinks back when exceeded.

props.name: seed
props.description: Terrain seed.

props.name: chrome
props.description: Sheet header, legend, scale bar, pin count and Clear button.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which fills its parent.

name: Exploded Assembly
description: An exploded-view drawing in Three.js: parts drop into place, separate along their vectors as numbered balloons draw out, with a live parts list.

props.name: parts
props.description: 1–12 parts: { id, label, description, kind (box | cylinder | frame), size, position, explode, color, material?, metalness? } in model units.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled view { selectedId | null, separation 0–1 in 0.01 steps, azimuth −75…75 }.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial view when uncontrolled. Defaults to the first part, assembled, turned 25°.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Every requested view. Throw to refuse it; the pose stays. Receives a copied view so host mutation cannot change the retained pose.

props.name: onValueCommit
props.description: A finished interaction the host accepted: a drag released, a key let go, a part picked, Reassemble. Receives an independent copy; mutating it cannot change the retained view.

props.name: title
props.description: The assembly's name in the toolbar.

props.name: path
props.description: Breadcrumb before the title.

props.name: unit
props.description: How model units read in the parts list, the size note and the stack height.

props.name: quality
props.description: Drawing-buffer budget: 400k or 800k pixels, DPR capped at 1.5 or 2, 2048px a side.

props.name: accent
props.description: Selected part's edges, balloon and list marker. Six-digit hex; invalid colours fall back to the theme accent. Numbered markers choose readable black or white text.

props.name: theme
props.description: Chrome and studio backdrop.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Locks the view; the parts list and notes stay readable.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root.

name: Route Globe
description: A grey dotted Three.js globe from real coastlines: land spreads out on first view, then accent arcs draw between cities, with comets, labelled markers and drag-to-spin.

props.name: routes
props.type: { from: [lat, lon]; to: [lat, lon]; fromLabel?: string; toLabel?: string }[]
props.description: Great-circle arcs with a travelling comet. Unique endpoints get a pulsing marker; labels show on hover, tap or keyboard turn.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one colour on the globe: arcs, comets and markers. Land, rim and atmosphere stay grey.

props.name: focus
props.description: Latitude and longitude that face the camera on mount; the land reveal spreads out from here.

props.name: speed
props.description: Multiplier for rotation and comet speed; 0 stops auto-rotation.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Drag or arrow keys to spin with inertia and tilt.

props.name: maxRoutes
props.description: Draw only the first N routes, so a sparser network can be shown without editing the array.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name; the route count and controls are appended.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which fills its parent.

name: Holo Metal Card
description: A brushed-metal membership card in Three.js with thin-film foil and etched type. It turns in out of the dark under a passing glint, tilts and flips.
usage: import { ThreeHoloCard } from "@/components/design-for-ai/three-holo-card";

props.name: issuer
props.description: Issuer wordmark, top left of the front.

props.name: tier
props.description: Tier name, set in italic serif.

props.name: holder
props.description: Cardholder name, upper-cased on the card.

props.name: number
props.description: Full number on the back; the front shows the last four.

props.name: expiry
props.description: Expiry, MM/YY.

props.name: since
props.description: Member-since year.

props.name: finePrint
props.default: Follows the issuer, plus a return address
props.description: Two lines of fine print on the back. The first names the issuer.

props.name: finish
props.description: Metal finish: base reflectance, edge polish and etch colour.

props.name: side
props.description: Controlled side. Omit to let the card manage it.

props.name: defaultSide
props.description: Initial side when uncontrolled.

props.name: onSideChange
props.description: Called when the card is flipped.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Pointer and device-orientation tilt. Flipping always works.

props.name: onReveal
props.description: Fires once as the card starts its turn-in on first view, so surrounding UI can follow it in.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which fills its parent.

name: Keycaps
description: Sculpted Three.js keycaps that drop onto their plate in reading order, then answer your real keyboard: caps sink on a spring and chords like ⌘K show a caption.
usage: import { ThreeKeycaps } from "@/components/design-for-ai/three-keycaps";

props.name: rows
props.description: Rows of caps, back row first (up to 10 caps). Each: id, label or glyph, sub word, KeyboardEvent codes, width in units, tone.

props.name: chords
props.description: Key-id combinations that light together and show a caption.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the accent-tone cap, and (28% lighter) the LED light that bleeds from beneath a pressed cap.

props.name: palette
props.description: The neutral cap plastics and legend ink: a preset name, or your own { alpha, mod, legend } colours (graphite is { alpha: "#34353a", mod: "#232428", legend: "#e6e6e6" }). Changing it recolours the caps in place.

props.name: demo
props.description: Press ⌘K once by itself the first time the caps come into view.

props.name: listen
props.description: Mirror the physical keyboard while the caps are on screen (ignored while typing in a field).

props.name: pressed
props.description: Key ids held down from outside, joined with "+" ("cmd+k"): the caps sink and the chord's caption shows, as if typed. Anything that names no key lets go.

props.name: showCaption
props.description: Show the caption row under the caps. The chord is still announced to screen readers when it is off.

props.name: captureShortcuts
props.description: Prevent the default action of a completed chord (e.g. ⌘K). Off by default so the host page's own shortcuts still work.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which fills its parent.

name: Material Inspector
description: A finish study in Three.js: one bevelled coupon under a studio light, with finishes that cross-fade, meters that glide and a key light you swing.

props.name: title
props.description: The sample's name in the toolbar.

props.name: path
props.description: Breadcrumb before the title.

props.name: materials
props.description: 1–8 finishes: { id, label, description, color (#rrggbb), metalness 0–1, roughness 0.15–1, transmission? 0–0.8 }.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled view { materialId, azimuth (−90…90, whole degrees), lightAngle (0…359) }.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial view when uncontrolled. Defaults to the first finish at 22° under a 315° light.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Every requested view. Throw to refuse it; the current view stays. Receives a copied view so host mutation cannot change the retained pose.

props.name: onValueCommit
props.description: A finished interaction the host accepted: a drag released, a key let go, a finish chosen, Reset. Receives an independent copy; mutating it cannot change the retained view.

props.name: quality
props.description: Drawing-buffer budget: 480k or 960k pixels, DPR capped at 1.5 or 2, 2048px a side.

props.name: theme
props.description: Chrome and studio backdrop.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Locks the view; the finish and its parameters stay readable.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root.

name: Particle Sphere
description: A Three.js sphere of 14,000 grey shader-lit particles that condense from a loose cloud on first view, wrapped in a self-drawing orbit. Touch tints it with one accent.
usage: import { ThreeParticleSphere } from "@/components/design-for-ai/three-particle-sphere";

props.name: accent
props.description: The one colour: particles swelling under the pointer and the ripple a click sends. The sphere itself is grey.

props.name: density
props.description: Particles on desktop; halved under 640px.

props.name: speed
props.description: Animation speed multiplier.

props.name: turbulence
props.description: Noise displacement strength, 0–1.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Lean toward the pointer, swell under it and ripple on click.

props.name: ring
props.description: Show the orbiting particle ring.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the host element, which fills its parent.

name: Voice Orb
description: A dark-glass voice orb whose rim draws itself on first view. One accent burns brighter per state as it listens to your mic, swirls in thought and pulses as it speaks.

props.name: state
props.description: Controlled state. Omit to let the built-in segmented control drive it.

props.name: defaultState
props.description: Starting state when uncontrolled.

props.name: onStateChange
props.description: Called when the control or the mic button changes state.

props.name: name
props.description: The assistant’s name, used in the idle caption and labels.

props.name: captions
props.type: { idle?: string; listening?: string; thinking?: string }
props.description: Caption per state. Mic status lines (waiting, blocked, missing) override listening.

props.name: speakingLines
props.description: Lines voiced by the synthetic speech envelope; the caption lights up word by word in sync with the pulses.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one colour: the orb's inner light and halo, the state dots and the mic level ring. States change its brightness (idle 35%, listening 100%, thinking 65%, speaking 85%), never its hue.

props.name: showControls
props.description: Show the state segmented control and the microphone button.

props.name: showCaption
props.description: Show the eyebrow and caption under the orb.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Tilt the orb gently toward the pointer.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root element.

name: Token Usage Meter
description: An AI usage meter for one budget cycle: a stacked bar by model, a tick that warms past 80%, and the day the budget runs out at this pace.

props.name: title
props.description: The small label above the figure.

props.name: used
props.description: Share of the cycle budget already used, in percent (0 to 120). Past 100 the budget is exceeded and the readout says by how much.

props.name: models
props.description: Segments on the bar, 1 to 4. The top models keep their own segment and the rest fold into Other models. 1 shows one total.

props.name: catalog
props.description: Each model's share of tokens and its price in dollars per million tokens. Shares are normalised.

props.name: budget
props.description: The cycle budget in tokens. Credits are 1,000 tokens each; dollars are priced from the catalog.

props.name: unit
props.description: What the bar and the figures count in. The bar's segments resize to the chosen unit.

props.name: softLimit
props.description: Percent of the budget where the tone shifts. The tick and its label warm, and the stretch of bar or projection past it gets an accent edge; the palette stays put.

props.name: cycleStart
props.description: First day of the cycle, ISO date. Used for the forecast and the day marker.

props.name: cycleEnd
props.description: Last day of the cycle, ISO date, inclusive.

props.name: today
props.description: The day the forecast is made on, ISO date. Pass the real date in production.

props.name: locale
props.description: Locale for compact numbers, dates and currency.

props.name: currency
props.description: ISO 4217 code shown when the unit is dollars.

props.name: forecast
props.description: Show the run-out forecast and the what-if slider beneath the legend. The slider speeds up the daily pace from today on; the share used never changes.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the forecast date, the tone past the soft limit and the what-if thumb.

props.name: theme
props.description: Surface and ink. Light deepens the accent for text so it stays readable on paper.

name: Hover Work Index
description: A dark studio work index in huge type: rows stagger in as their rules draw, and on desktop a cover card follows the cursor on springs, tilting with velocity.

props.name: projects
props.description: year, client, discipline, href, cover art key, and an optional chip colour (defaults to accent).

props.name: title
props.description: Section title.

props.name: eyebrow
props.description: Mono label above the title.

props.name: intro
props.description: Short intro beside the title.

props.name: previewLabel
props.description: Chip label on the floating card.

props.name: columns
props.description: Column labels over the rows on wide containers.

props.name: accent
props.description: Fill of the active row's arrow chip and the focus ring.

props.name: theme
props.description: Near-black or paper. Covers keep their own colours.
